description: Search official Taiwan emission factors by keyword, category, type, year or unit. Returns factor IDs to pass to get_emission_factor and calculate_emissions. Covers electricity, tap water, fuel combustion, refrigerants and other fluorinated gases (GWP values), and product carbon footprint factors; returns an explicit not-found message rather than a near match. Refrigerant blends such as R-410A are not listed: pass their components as refrigerant_blend to calculate_emissions, calculate_batch, compare_emissions or build_inventory. 以關鍵字、類別、類型、年度或單位搜尋台灣官方排放係數，回傳的係數 ID 可交給 get_emission_factor 與 calculate_emissions。目前收錄電力、自來水、燃料燃燒、冷媒等含氟氣體（溫暖化潛勢）與產品碳足跡；查不到會明確說明，不會給相近的替代品。R-410A 這類混合冷媒不在表內，請把成分以 refrigerant_blend 交給 calculate_emissions、calculate_batch、compare_emissions 或 build_inventory 計算。

category.description: 類別：electricity 電力、water 自來水、fuel_combustion 燃料燃燒、refrigerant 冷媒等含氟氣體、product_footprint 產品碳足跡。

factor_type.description: 係數類型，用來區分固定燃燒與移動燃燒等。

query.description: 關鍵字，繁體中文或英文，例如 電力、柴油、自來水、gasoline。多個關鍵字以空白分隔。

unit.description: 係數分母的單位，例如 kWh、m3、TJ。

name: search_emission_factors
title: Search emission factors
